scope_zh: 记录本投稿已实际完成的清权输入、约束检查、候选枚举、Pareto筛选、负例拒绝、载体同步和审查整改；不公开隐藏提示词、内部推理、凭据或系统信息，也不把离线运行写成现场部署。
scope_en: Record the cleared-input, constraint-check, candidate enumeration, Pareto filtering, negative-case rejection, carrier synchronization, and review-response work actually completed for this submission. Hidden prompts, internal reasoning, credentials, and system information are excluded, and offline runs are not represented as field deployment.

execution_facts.planning_question: Assign S01-S12 to three differentiated fields without coordinate changes, preserve hard gates and staffed/static fallback, compare a baseline and alternatives, and expose unresolved dependencies for human review.

frozen_inputs.role: scenario catalog, allowed roles, hard gates, internal ordinal evaluation metadata
read-only provisional overall geometry; not an official redline
users, space, rights, baseline, metric, human gate, stop/exit, and risk for S01-S12

run_steps.actual_action: Validate required files, source IDs, rights status, provisional geometry status, and input hashes before candidate work.
run_steps.human_boundary: A human remains responsible for factual authorization, legal sufficiency, and use of any non-public input.

run_steps.actual_action: Apply fixed assignments, field cardinality, unique coverage, fallback requirements, prohibited-flag checks, and a zero-coordinate-change policy.
hard_gates: S01/S02 fixed north, S03 fixed south, S12 fixed experimental central role
each field preserves at least one staffed or static fallback
PII, biometrics, medical, regulatory, and approval flags are forbidden

run_steps.actual_action: Enumerate all assignments that satisfy the frozen hard gates in deterministic scenario and role order.
Retain non-dominated assignments across internal ordinal public-interest, fallback, reversibility, affinity, maintenance, dependency, and load-spread criteria.
run_steps.limitation: Internal ordinals compare authored options only; they are not field performance, engineering feasibility, public preference, or approval evidence.

run_steps.actual_action: Run six authored negative fixtures covering fixed-role violation, duplicate/missing coverage, cardinality overflow, PII flag, missing fallback, and coordinate mutation.
Present baseline and two alternatives with trade-offs, failure cases, provisional limits, and release/modify/reject/pause/rollback/exit fields.
Synchronize the approved evidence boundary into bilingual proposal text, figures, offline HTML, A3/A0, metrics, matrices, rights notes, and manifest hashes.
Convert current-head reviewer findings into bounded corrections: rights closure, removal of unsupported numeric floor ranges, English figure legibility, and blocker ownership/trigger classification.

frozen_outputs.role: candidate, Pareto, negative-fixture, and limitation record

failure_if: any frozen input or output hash changes without a new ledger version
HumanDecision is represented as completed without a real accountable human record

proves: a replayable participant-authored offline planning comparison exists
multiple feasible and Pareto candidates were generated under frozen hard gates
authored negative cases were rejected deterministically
the Agent workflow exposes evidence, constraints, trade-offs, and unresolved human decisions
does_not_prove: field performance, public acceptance, accessibility outcome, cost certainty, or implementation authorization
professional, organizer, property, heritage, fire, transport, or utility sign-off
